title: brachypterum timorense
intro: Brachypterum timorense, commonly known as Timor winged thistle or Timor knapweed, is a plant species belonging to the family Compositae. It is reported to have various health benefits, including its use in traditional medicine to treat fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Brachypterum timorense include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its traditional uses. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
